name: net_join_terrain_screen
about: The join without the standard prologue: the terrain screen's keep-alives (C00 every 20 screen updates) while waiting long for chunks, keys pressed while the screen is up (swallowed: still up after it closes), the chunks, the spawn S08, then pressing again (the 1.8.9 oracle's long_terrain_download and keys_held_through_terrain_screen inputs).

steps.note: keys pressed under the terrain screen
the spawn S08 closes the screen
